name: Revenged Love
description: After Wu Suo-wei's girlfriend dumps him, he decides to get revenge by seducing her new boyfriend, Chi Cheng! It started as a game, but falling in love was never part of the plan.

videos.title: A Gentleman Will Surely Take Revenge
videos.overview: After heartbreak, Wu Suowei plots revenge and collides with Chi Cheng in love and rivalry.

videos.title: Ex-Girlfriend's Current Boyfriend
videos.overview: Wu Suowei schemes chance meetings with Chi Cheng while diving deeper into snake-raising.

videos.title: The Apprentice Has Graduated
videos.overview: A park meeting sparks first hand-holding, while an injury reveals dangerous secrets.

videos.title: He's the One You Like?
videos.overview: Wu Suowei fakes brains to lure Chi Cheng, leading to a kiss that blurs truth and lies.

videos.title: Just Charge Forward, the Bully Has Your Back
videos.overview: Chi Cheng shows care, and after tension, Wu Suowei accepts his invitation to stay over.

videos.title: My Heart is All Shaken Up
videos.overview: Chi Cheng keeps Wu Suowei’s gifts, but past loves and fears complicate their growing bond.

videos.title: Anyone Can Be Mad at Me But You
videos.overview: Chi Cheng’s awkward family visit stirs old ties, while Wu Suowei suspects rare stolen snakes.

videos.title: I Decide Who You're Missing
videos.overview: Wu Suowei dreams big with Chi Cheng’s support, while jealousy sparks a deadly plot.

videos.title: Snakes Aren't More Important than People
videos.overview: A snake smuggling tip ends in blood and hospital care, deepening Wu and Chi’s bond.

videos.title: Can You Turn Straight Again after Being Bent?
videos.overview: Wu Suowei rejects Yue Yue, but doubts about his sexuality ignite anger in Chi Cheng.

videos.title: Come On, Let’s Go Home and Get Registered
videos.overview: Possessive sparks fly as Wu Suowei demands exclusivity, and they plan a future together.

videos.title: Why Is He Playing by His Own Rules?
videos.overview: Chi Cheng and Wu Suowei embrace commitment, marking the start of their true romance.

videos.title: Top 10 Best Boyfriend
videos.overview: Wu Suowei confesses his motives, while another couple’s shifting bond complicates the group.

videos.title: Get Rid of Your Sensitive and Inferior Past
videos.overview: Chi Cheng visits Wu’s mother, but Wang Shuo’s return brings jealousy and looming storms.

videos.title: Who Could Resist Their First Love?
videos.overview: Wu Suowei visits Wang Shuo, breaking Chi Cheng’s heart and straining fragile bonds.

videos.title: To Like Means to Accept without Limits, to Love Means to Nitpick Unreasonably
videos.overview: Old videos spark jealousy, but medical records reveal Wang Shuo’s painful truth.

videos.title: When Hatred Runs Too Deep, Love Can No Longer Be Born
videos.overview: Lies, fights, and Wang Shuo’s meddling test Wu and Chi, as old truths resurface.

videos.title: Don't You Know if I Ever Loved You?
videos.overview: Yue Yue resurfaces, Wang Shuo schemes, and Chi Cheng uncovers Wu Suowei’s hidden plan.

videos.title: This Road Will Be Tough
videos.overview: Wu Suowei learns Chi cared for his mother, sparking both blessings and painful doubts.

videos.title: Men Are Like Periods
videos.overview: Grief breaks Wu, but Chi mends him, and together they stage a fake breakup to help friends.

videos.title: The Father-in-law
videos.overview: Wu Suowei is kidnapped, and Chi Cheng suspects his father as he launches a rescue.

videos.title: I Want to Bring You Home
videos.overview: Chi rescues Wu, but a tax scandal lands him in custody, forcing Wu to fight for him.

videos.title: I Only Want You
videos.overview: Wu sells his home to clear Chi’s name, finally reuniting with him in the detention center.

videos.title: I Have a Home Again
videos.overview: Chi regains freedom, buys back Wu’s lost home, and they promise a shared happy future.
